title: Price list
purpose: Create or edit staff pricing. Quote lines copy prices when saved; a list edit never changes already stored quote prices.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Project managers and admins can use price lists and quotes. Other staff roles do not grant this access. Admin includes the project manager role. A superuser flag alone supplies no application role.

items.label: Name
items.description: Required unique name, up to 120 characters; uniqueness ignores letter case.

items.label: Description
items.description: Optional staff-only explanation; not included in the client quote document.

items.label: Active (can be quoted)
items.description: Checked by default for a new list. Clear to prevent new quote selection; existing drafts may retain this list.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Shown and required when editing; omitted when creating. Explain changes to details, availability or prices. Kept in audit history.

sections.title: Prices
paragraphs: Rows include active tests on active methods and all tests already priced on an existing list, ordered by matrix, analyte, method code and version. Existing entries remain visible after retirement; new entries require active tests on active methods. Price rows have no filtering or pagination.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Substance or measurement identified by the catalog test.

items.label: Method version
items.description: Specific method/version for this test. Different versions can have different prices.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Water, Wastewater or Soil distinguishes the sample material.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Analytical result unit for identifying the test, not the charging basis.

items.label: Price (USD)
items.description: Optional exact US dollars per sample, from 0 to 9,999,999,999.99 with at most two decimal places. Blank means no price is offered on this list; clearing a saved price removes that entry. Zero is a real price.

items.label: Create price list
items.description: Save a new list and reopen it for editing; an empty list is allowed.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Save details and prices with the reason. Refused if the list changed after opening; reload and review current prices.

items.label: Cancel / Price lists
items.description: Return to the list directory without saving.

items.label: Open catalog
items.description: Shown if no tests are available to price; opens the test catalog. Catalog changes require their own permissions.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: Shows up to the first 20 recorded events in oldest-first order. Each event identifies action, time, actor and any reason. Changes and their audit event save together. The timeline does not display every stored before-and-after value.

items.label: Required fields and errors
items.description: Asterisks mark required fields. Errors appear beside fields or above the form; entered values stay available for correction after validation fails. A stale-record error requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: When this form opens in a dialog, change its size without saving. Small screens already use the full screen.

items.label: Close form / Cancel
items.description: Leave without saving. If the dialog detects edits, Keep editing returns to the form and Discard changes leaves without saving.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Retry if loading the dialog failed. During saving, wait for the request to finish; the submit button indicates work is running.
